description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Returns a checkout link for a plan from list_plans (`interval` monthly or annual, default monthly). A HUMAN opens it and pays: Stripe Checkout for individual plans, the organization set-up page for org plans, or the plan page when the account already has a card. This call never charges anything. Only call it when the user asks to upgrade.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/billing/checkout.)

plan.description: A plan id from list_plans (e.g. starter, pro).

name: start_checkout
title: Start a checkout
